rationale: All 11 findings from code-review-final (1 critical, 10 major) are resolved. Personal CLI config and analytics logs were removed from the branch (CR-001). AssistantForm now only sends tool_permissions when isCodemieAssistant && toolPermissionsEnabled, dropping the duplicate top-level keys otherwise (CR-002). ChatAiMessage restores the hideToolOutputs gate while still rendering an interrupted/pending thought, and hides Allow/Deny on shared pages (CR-003, CR-004 critical broken-access-control). useToolPermissions now fails closed to ASK_FOR_APPROVAL on an assistant-fetch failure instead of silently widening to AUTO_APPROVE (CR-005), guards against a superseded fetch overwriting state via a cancelled flag (CR-006), and validates the conversation's toolCallPolicy against the enum with a safe fallback (CR-007, from the prior fix-up). resumeToolCall now takes the specific thoughtId being resolved, no-ops when no matching interrupted thought remains, optimistically clears interrupted/in_progress before sending, and guards empty/stale history before indexing (CR-008, CR-009, CR-010). mapConversationUpdatePayload adds a toolCallPolicy -> tool_call_policy case so the policy override persists across reloads (CR-011). Full unit suite (471 files, 4986 passed, 1 skipped) and typecheck are clean after the fixes; backend test harness was run separately and passed.

finding_status.evidence: Personal .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json restored and the three docs/codemie/analytics/*.json session logs removed in commit 66ab4b334.

AssistantForm.tsx:352 area — tool_permissions is only included in the save payload when isCodemieAssistant && toolPermissionsEnabled, else assistant?.tool_permissions is passed through unchanged; duplicate top-level keys removed.
ChatAiMessage.tsx:245 — `{(!hideToolOutputs || thought.interrupted) && <Thought thought={thought} />}` restores the hideToolOutputs gate while keeping the interrupted/pending thought visible.
ChatAiMessage.tsx:246 — `{thought.interrupted && !currentChat?.isWorkflow && !isSharedPage && (...)}` hides Allow/Deny on shared/read-only pages.

useToolPermissions.ts — assistant fetches now resolve to {assistant, failed}; if any fetch fails, assistantResolved is set to {policy: ASK_FOR_APPROVAL, allowOverride: false, loaded: true} instead of folding failures into the AUTO_APPROVE reduction.

useToolPermissions.ts — the resolution effect now sets a local `cancelled` flag, checks it before calling setAssistantResolved in the Promise.all `.then`, and returns a cleanup that sets `cancelled = true`.
Resolved in the prior fix-up (commit 66ab4b334); useToolPermissions.ts validates currentChat?.toolCallPolicy against Object.values(ToolCallPolicy) before use, falling back to undefined.
chatGeneration.ts resumeToolCall — `targetThought.interrupted = false; targetThought.in_progress = true` are set optimistically before _sendRequest, mirroring resumeWorkflowExecution.
chatGeneration.ts resumeToolCall — `if (lastHistoryIndex < 0 || !chat.history[lastHistoryIndex]?.length) return Promise.resolve()` guards against empty/stale history before indexing.

resumeToolCall now takes `(thoughtId, action)`; it finds `lastHistoryItem.thoughts?.find((t) => t.id === thoughtId && t.interrupted)` and no-ops if there is no match. ChatAiMessage.tsx passes thought.id on both the Allow and Deny onClick handlers. chatGeneration.resumeToolCall.test.ts covers clearing the flag, sendRequest payload, and the no-match no-op case.
chats.ts mapConversationUpdatePayload adds `case 'toolCallPolicy': payload.tool_call_policy = value; break`, so updateChat({toolCallPolicy}) now PUTs the snake_case field the backend expects.
